decision: 5 second time penalty. (2 penalty points awarded, 7 points in total for the 12 month period)
event_name: Haas F1 Team Document 46 Date 24 June 2018 Time 17:32 2018 FRENCH GRAND PRIX 21 - 24 June 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 8 collided with Car 31 on the Start/Finish straight at the Start of the race.
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, particularly on board vision from cars following Car 8 off the start line. Car 8 made a sudden and significant move to the left colliding with Car 31. There was no other car on the right of Car 8 at the time. All Competitors are hereby reminded of their right to appeal certain

stewards: as set out in the International Sporting Code
